methods.evidence: Number(value) returns a numeric primitive on normal completion, including NaN; coercion may throw.
Number.prototype.toString returns a string on normal completion; invalid receivers or radix may throw.
String.match returns a match array or null; a non-null assertion does not guard its result.
RegExp.exec returns a match array or null.

Map.get returns V or undefined when the key is absent. Exclude null only when the receiver's resolved value type V excludes null; uncertain types retain the conservative nullish result. Key presence and prior writes are not tracked.
Array.find may miss or return a null/undefined element. Predicate callback execution is not modeled.
Map.has returns a boolean without asserting non-null stored values.
Map.set returns its receiver; element state is not summarized.
Array.isArray returns a boolean and its true edge excludes null/undefined; project lookalikes must not inherit this predicate.

ECMA-262 JSON.parse: normal return may be null; undefined requires a callable reviver. Absent/null/undefined reviver excludes undefined. Malformed input throws; reviver execution is not modeled. https://tc39.es/ecma262/multipage/structured-data.html#sec-json.parse
JSON.stringify may return undefined for a non-serializable top-level value or a replacer result.
String.trim returns a string on normal completion.
String.split returns an array on normal completion.
Array.slice returns an array on normal completion; element nullness is not inferred.
Loaded OpenHarmony @ohos.util.json.d.ts parse declaration returns Object | null. Exact @kit.ArkTS JSON alias target; Transformer execution is not modeled.
